content_sections.heading: About BDO Matiali Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Office of the Block Development Officer, Matiali Block, Jalpaiguri - 735206, is a block-level office of the Government of West Bengal, located at Chalsa. Under Paschim Banga Samagra Shiksha Mission, an Ashram hostel has been built in one school of Matiali Block – Matelli High School (H.S.) – and the hostel is for girls. The Lady Tutors selected through this notice will work at this hostel.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 9 Lady Tutor posts, one in each subject, all reserved for women (মহিলা). Six are at the Secondary Level and three at the Higher Secondary Level. The notice does not give a category-wise (UR/SC/ST/OBC) break-up of the posts.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The application form also asks for work experience with the name of the post, duration and organisation, but the notice does not make experience compulsory. All 9 posts are for women only. The applicant must be a local resident; as proof, a Residential Certificate issued by the concerned Gram Panchayat Pradhan must be given. The applicant must be a member of a Self Help Group (স্ব-নির্ভর গোষ্ঠী); as proof, the SHG ID must be given. An active mobile number and the applicant's own full address must be written in the application. The age limit for all Lady Tutor posts is 21 to 60 years, counted as on 01/01/2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the subject-wise eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: All appointments will be on a temporary contractual basis. A selected Lady Tutor must stay in the hostel full time. The place of work is the Ashram hostel for girls at Matelli High School (H.S.), Matiali Block, Jalpaiguri. The notice does not mention any allowance, the length of the contract or its renewal.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BDO Matiali Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only offline, through the Drop Box at the BDO office, from 25 November 2026 to 4 December 2026 till 5 PM, during office hours, excluding all holidays. Applications received through any other mode will be rejected. Fill in the Application Format printed on page 3 of the notice, writing the post applied for in "Application for the Post of". Give the details asked: name in block letters, father's name, spouse name (if married), full postal address, date of birth, age as on 01/01/2026, caste, gender, educational qualification table, work experience, contact number, SHG ID No, EPIC No and AADHAAR No. Affix a recent coloured passport size photograph attested by the candidate, and sign the form with place and date. Attach the self-attested photocopies listed under Documents Required. Put the application with all documents in a sealed envelope addressed to "To The Block Development Officer, Matiali Development Block" and mention the subject on it. Drop the envelope in the Drop Box kept at the Office of the Block Development Officer, Matiali Development Block, Chalsa, Jalpaiguri, by 4 December 2026, 5 PM. Selection for all posts will be by interview only. The list of candidates nominated for the interview for all posts will be published at the Matiali Block office and on the district website www.jalpaiguri.gov.in, and nominated candidates must download it from the district website. The notice does not give the interview date.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: One passport size photograph (recent, coloured, attested by the candidate) Self-attested photocopy of the Residential Certificate issued by the concerned Gram Panchayat Pradhan (proof of residence) Self-attested photocopy of the SHG ID Self-attested photocopy of the EPIC (Voter card) Self-attested photocopy of the Aadhaar Card Self-attested proof of age Self-attested Madhyamik admit card and marksheet Self-attested Higher Secondary marksheet Self-attested Graduate marksheet and other educational/essential qualification certificates Self-attested experience certificate, if any

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions

faq.question: Q1. How many Lady Tutor posts are in BDO Matiali Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 Lady Tutor posts, all for women: six at the Secondary Level (Bengali, English, Math, History, Physical Science, Life Science) and three at the Higher Secondary Level (English, History, Political Science).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Matiali Lady Tutor posts?
faq.answer: Applications can be dropped from 25 November 2026 to 4 December 2026 till 5 PM, during office hours, excluding holidays.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Lady Tutor posts?
faq.answer: Secondary Level posts need a Graduate degree, and Higher Secondary Level posts need Honours Graduate (Graduate with Hons.), Postgraduate degree (M.A.) Master degree; B.Ed. is preferable for both.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BDO Matiali Lady Tutor posts?
faq.answer: Applicants must be 21 to 60 years old as on 01/01/2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Lady Tutor in Matiali Block?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 3500/- per month for all 9 posts.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the Matiali Lady Tutor posts?
faq.answer: Fill the Application Format, attach the self-attested documents, seal it in an envelope addressed to "To The Block Development Officer, Matiali Development Block" with the subject mentioned, and drop it in the Drop Box at the BDO office, Chalsa, Jalpaiguri.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Lady Tutor posts?
faq.answer: Selection for all posts is by interview only, and the list of candidates nominated for the interview will be published at the Matiali Block office and on www.jalpaiguri.gov.in.

faq.question: Q8. Who can apply for BDO Matiali Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only local women who are members of a Self Help Group can apply, with a Residential Certificate from the Gram Panchayat Pradhan and their SHG ID as proof.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one Lady Tutor post?
faq.answer: No. If an applicant applies for more than one post, her application will be cancelled.

faq.question: Q10. Is the Lady Tutor job permanent, and must the tutor stay in the hostel?
faq.answer: No, all appointments are on a temporary contractual basis, and a selected Lady Tutor must stay in the hostel full time.
